scope.objective: 한글 우선 Research Control Center V2를 고밀도이되 읽기 쉽고, 키보드·스크린리더·모바일·인쇄에서 사용할 수 있는 정적 애플리케이션으로 설계한다.

observed_v1_issues: 23개 anchor가 한 번에 노출되어 현재 위치와 우선순위를 찾기 어렵다.
큰 hero와 연속 section/card 구조가 1440x900 첫 화면의 작업 정보를 밀어낸다.
구성요소·claim·risk가 같은 카드 문법으로 반복되어 정보 위계가 약하다.
상태가 badge 색과 긴 설명에 분산되어 구현·실행·근거 점검·무결성·재현·과학 검증을 빠르게 비교하기 어렵다.
기술 근거와 쉬운 설명이 동시에 노출되어 한글 본문 밀도가 높고 세부 정보의 점진적 공개가 부족하다.
모바일 규칙은 단순 1열 변환에 머물러 fixed navigation, SVG canvas, drawer, chart의 구체 동작이 없다.
design_principles: 현재 단계, 다음 작업, P0 위험을 첫 화면의 최상위 시각 위계에 둔다.
상태를 하나의 완료 색으로 합치지 않고 코드·실행·근거 점검·결과 무결성·독립 재현·과학 검증의 6축으로 표시한다.
색상은 의미를 보조하며 모든 상태는 텍스트, 모양 또는 아이콘과 함께 제공한다.
쉬운 설명을 기본값으로 하고 경로·symbol·schema·hash는 기술 상세에서 점진적으로 공개한다.
장식보다 비교, 추적, 선택, 근거 접근을 우선한다.
한글 본문은 16px 이상, line-height 1.6을 기본으로 하며 긴 문단 대신 2~3줄 요약과 구조화된 목록을 사용한다.
애니메이션 없이도 현재 view, 선택 node, drawer 상태를 이해할 수 있어야 한다.

rules: green does not mean scientific validation unless the adjacent text says 과학적 검증 완료.
blocked and critical use red with an icon and text label, never red alone.
conditional and warning use amber with a label; do not use amber for completed states.
unknown, not-run, unvalidated, and unconfirmed remain distinct tokens in text even when sharing gray styling.
charts use patterns, direct labels, and tables in addition to color.

marker_contract.complete: solid circle plus visible label and aria-label
marker_contract.partial_or_conditional: half-filled or diamond marker plus visible label and aria-label
marker_contract.not_complete: hollow circle plus visible label and aria-label
marker_contract.blocked: octagon or exclamation marker plus visible label and aria-label
marker_contract.unknown: question mark marker plus visible label and aria-label

prohibited: single green card that implies all six dimensions are complete
audited translated as 검증 완료 without evidence or scientific qualifier
PASS badge used as a proxy for scientific validation

korean_typography.compact_table_minimum: 14px only for secondary metadata; primary values remain 16px
korean_typography.paragraph_target_lines: 2-4 lines in overview; longer text moves to drawer
korean_typography.technical_identifier_behavior: monospace, overflow-wrap:anywhere, word-break:break-word only inside identifiers
korean_typography.english_term_rule: first user-facing occurrence uses 한글 설명 (English term); code identifiers and enum tokens remain verbatim

wide_1920.architecture: entire SVG visible without horizontal scrolling at default fit

desktop_1440.overview_rule: current stage, phase rail, compact architecture, top actions, pilot chart, gates, risks, and last changes must be discoverable without reading a long report
desktop_1440.architecture: 14 top-level nodes fit at default zoom; controls remain sticky

compact_desktop_1366.shell: 76px icon-plus-short-label navigation or collapsible 220px navigation + workspace; drawer overlay max-width 390px
compact_desktop_1366.overview: secondary panels collapse to two-column or disclosure regions; core stage and next task stay above fold
compact_desktop_1366.architecture: fit-to-width with minimum node font 14px; optional horizontal pan by keyboard and scroll

mobile_390.shell: 56px header + single-column workspace; navigation opens modal sheet
mobile_390.drawer: full-screen fixed sheet with title, close button, easy/technical tabs, and internal scroll
mobile_390.charts: stack vertically; labels outside bars; tables remain horizontally scrollable only when unavoidable
mobile_390.architecture: viewport-width frame with horizontal overflow and explicit 확대/축소/맞춤 controls; nodes retain 44px hit targets
mobile_390.tables: catalog and roadmap expose a card-like row summary with a details action; no clipped columns

application_shell.navigation: five primary items only; current item uses aria-current=page and a non-color marker
application_shell.workspace: only one primary view is perceivable at a time; hidden views use hidden attribute and are absent from tab order
application_shell.drawer: desktop overlay does not shift architecture; mobile full-screen sheet; focus moves to heading on open and returns to opener on close
application_shell.hash_navigation: view hash changes preserve browser back/forward; missing hash falls back to overview without error

focus_and_keyboard.global_focus: outline: var(--focus-outline); outline-offset: var(--focus-offset); never remove outline without equivalent
focus_and_keyboard.minimum_target: 44x44 CSS px for navigation, controls, drawer close, tabs, and architecture node selection
primary_navigation: Tab visits five menu items in visual order.
Enter or Space activates a view.
mobile menu button exposes aria-expanded and aria-controls.
architecture_nodes: Each top-level node is a native button or focusable SVG group with role=button, tabindex=0, accessible name, and described-by status summary.
Enter or Space selects a node and opens the drawer.
Arrow keys move to the nearest node in the stated direction; Tab may still traverse nodes in documented flow order.
Escape closes the drawer or clears architecture selection.
Selected node exposes aria-pressed=true or aria-selected=true; upstream/downstream highlight is also announced in an aria-live polite region.
Zoom buttons, reset, fit, search, stage filter, risk filter, frozen-only, and unknown-edge toggle are keyboard operable.
drawer: role=dialog and aria-modal=true only when it behaves as an overlay modal; otherwise use complementary with an accessible heading.
Focus is trapped only for modal/mobile mode.
Easy/technical controls use a proper tablist/tab/tabpanel pattern or two explicit buttons with aria-pressed.
Close button is first or immediately after heading; Escape closes; focus returns to triggering node or table row.
tables: Rows are not click-only. Each row contains a named 상세 보기 button.
Column headers use scope=col; sortable headers, if added, expose aria-sort.
Filter result count is announced with aria-live=polite without moving focus.

semantic_structure: SVG has role=img and aria-labelledby pointing to a Korean title and description.
A visible HTML heading precedes the map; a hidden textual flow list mirrors node/edge order for non-visual users.
Lane groups include accessible lane names: 데이터·후보 탐색, 관계·규칙 구성, 실행·탐지, 평가·검증.
Node accessible name combines user-facing name, lane, and concise six-axis status summary.
Edge title names source, destination, evidence class, and verified/conditional state.

edge_styles.frozen_scientific_execution: 3px solid #173B63 with arrowhead and text legend 실제 frozen 경로
edge_styles.code_or_test_verified: 1.5px solid #55708C with arrowhead and text legend 코드·테스트 확인
edge_styles.authority_or_binding_gap: 2px dashed #B42318 with gap marker and text legend 권한·결속 gap
edge_styles.legacy_or_reference: 1.5px solid #98A2B3 with reduced contrast and text legend legacy/reference

highlight_behavior: Selected node receives a 3px blue stroke and a text badge 선택됨.
Upstream nodes receive a blue-gray outline; downstream nodes receive a green outline; unrelated nodes reduce opacity no lower than 0.35.
Do not rely on glow or animation to indicate selection.
When frozen-only filter hides nodes or edges, the visible node/edge count is announced.
architecture_svg_accessibility.fallback: A synchronized HTML list or compact table exposes every top-level node and every edge, including evidence state, when SVG is unavailable or for printing.

general: Each chart has a visible Korean title, one-sentence interpretation boundary, exact values, and an adjacent data table.
SVG charts use role=img plus title/desc; decorative gridlines and shapes are aria-hidden.
Data series are direct-labeled. Legends never depend on color swatches alone.
Axis scale and transformations are named in visible text and SVG description.
Tables remain visible in print and may be visually collapsed on screen only with an accessible disclosure.

recall_chart.recommended: four horizontal bars on a common 0-14 unit scale
recall_chart.warning: 14개 연속 공격 구간 단위; 통계적 독립성 미확인
recall_chart.prohibited: percent-only bars that hide the 14-unit denominator

far_chart.recommended: two aligned panels: low-range panel for D0, D2 V1, D2 V2 and full-range panel including D1, with identical unit labels and exact values
far_chart.alternative: log scale only when clearly labeled 로그 눈금 and zero handling is explicit
far_chart.preferred_reason: aligned panels make the D1 magnitude obvious without compressing the three lower values or implying linear equivalence across a broken axis
far_chart.warning: FAR/hour는 point-level FPR이 아니라 정상 false episode / normal exposure hour

overlap_matrix.recommended: native 2x2 HTML table as the primary visualization with cell counts 10, 1, 3, 0
overlap_matrix.accessible_summary: D0와 D1 모두 탐지 10, D0만 탐지 1, D1만 탐지 3, 둘 다 미탐 0
overlap_matrix.prohibited: Venn diagram without exact cell counts

overview.density: 12-column grid on desktop; current stage and next task occupy the strongest positions; no large decorative hero
overview.summary_limit: top 3 actions, top 5 risks, last 3 milestones, EXP-01 through EXP-05 compact gates
overview.prose_limit: approximately 1000-1200 visible words maximum, preferably below 800 at load

cards.use: only for distinct summary units such as current phase, one action, one risk, or one metric
cards.avoid: 32-component card wall, all claims as cards, all risks as cards
cards.description_limit: 2-3 lines; overflow content moves to drawer

tables.header: sticky within long catalog; Korean display labels while registry schema tokens remain in technical details
tables.zebra: subtle alternate #F8FAFC only; selected row adds a blue left border and text label
tables.overflow: desktop horizontal overflow only as last resort; mobile prioritizes summary columns and details button

warnings.pilot: blue-gray information callout with 정보 icon and concise Korean wording
warnings.blocked: red-bordered callout with 진행 전 해결 필요 label
warnings.frequency: place contextually once per relevant screen; do not repeat the full caveat in every panel

1440x900: Exactly five primary navigation items are visible.
Current stage, exact next task, P0 count, phase rail, and compact architecture map are discoverable without scanning a long page.
Architecture view shows 14 top-level nodes at default fit and the map dominates the workspace.
Drawer can open without hiding its close control or primary map controls.
1366x768: No horizontal page scroll; architecture canvas may have a labeled internal scroll region.
Header, navigation, architecture controls, and key status remain usable at 200% browser zoom where practicable.
Important actions are not pushed below decorative content.
1920x1080: Content does not stretch beyond readable measures; tables and architecture use the extra width, prose does not.
Drawer and architecture can be visible side-by-side without excessive empty space.
390x844: No clipped Korean text or inaccessible off-screen controls.
Mobile menu is operable by keyboard and touch and closes with Escape or explicit close.
Drawer becomes full-screen, preserves focus, and exposes both easy and technical modes.
Charts stack and every exact value remains visible.
All touch targets are at least 44x44 CSS px.

reduced_motion.css_contract: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { *, *::before, *::after { scroll-behavior: auto !important; animation-duration: 0.01ms !important; animation-iteration-count: 1 !important; transition-duration: 0.01ms !important; } }
behavior: Zoom and fit do not animate.
No auto-scrolling, pulsing, parallax, or looping chart animation is permitted.

print_behavior.purpose: produce a legible evidence handout, not an interactive screenshot
rules: Hide navigation controls, search controls, zoom buttons, mobile menu, drawer close, and purely interactive hints.
Show page title, scientific authority short ref, generated timestamp, pilot warnings, architecture fallback list, chart data tables, and selected technical evidence links as text.
Force white background, black or dark text, 1px neutral borders, and remove shadows.
Use landscape orientation for architecture/catalog pages when supported.
Avoid breaking status rails, chart plus table, experiment rows, and callouts across pages.
Expand only the currently selected drawer detail; do not print all 32 technical records unless Catalog view is explicitly printed.
Expose link targets after external or file links only when useful; do not print full SHA strings on overview.

first_pass_checks: 전체 연구 흐름과 현재 단계가 10초 안에 발견된다.
정확한 다음 작업과 상위 P0가 10초 안에 발견된다.
Architecture map이 시각 위계의 중심이며 카드 벽처럼 보이지 않는다.
D1 FAR가 다른 방법보다 매우 높다는 사실이 왜곡 없이 즉시 보인다.
구현 상태와 과학 검증 상태가 분리되어 보인다.
전체 hash와 raw registry 설명이 기본 화면을 지배하지 않는다.
영문은 기술 식별자와 최초 병기된 용어 중심이며 사용자 설명은 한글 우선이다.
interaction_checks: five-view hash navigation works with browser back/forward
every top-level node opens a drawer by mouse, Enter, and Space
selection, upstream, downstream, and unrelated states are visually and textually distinct
Escape closes drawer and focus returns to opener
easy/technical mode switch updates aria state and does not lose focus
mobile navigation and full-screen drawer do not trap users
accessibility_checks: semantic landmarks and one h1 per view shell
no color-only status or edge meaning
all SVGs have title/desc and HTML fallback
zoom to 200% does not hide required controls
Korean text uses keep-all wrapping and does not clip
visual_qa_protocol.refinement_requirement: After the first screenshots, rank the three largest visual/usability failures, revise shared implementation once, rebuild all target views, and rerun the full checklist.

automatable_checks: skip link targets an existing main landmark
all architecture nodes have tabindex and accessible name
all drawer openers reference an existing drawer
all charts have title, desc, and adjacent table
all status markers include visible label or aria-label
CSS contains prefers-reduced-motion and print media queries
no external CDN or remote font
mobile menu button includes aria-expanded and aria-controls
all top-level node hit areas meet 44px minimum in computed CSS
technical path/hash containers use monospace and wrap
registry enum token remains visible in technical detail when translated display text is used
non_automatable_checks: Current stage, next task, and P0 are discoverable within 10 seconds.
D1 FAR visualization is prominent but not sensationalized.
Architecture map is understandable without reading every edge.
Korean wording wraps naturally at all required viewports.
The page reads as an analytical operations dashboard rather than a long report.
Easy mode is understandable without technical identifiers; technical mode retains authoritative identifiers.

priority_order: architecture SVG semantics and keyboard selection
drawer focus management and easy/technical modes
accessible pilot charts and overlap table
